create_DummyDataset: create a DummyDataset that generates synthetic RGB images with index-based pixel values for testing
create_and_validate: create and validate an FFCV image pipeline by writing and loading raw or JPEG encoded images
make_and_read_cifar_subset: make a CIFAR-10 subset dataset and write it to FFCV format then read it back with a Loader
test_raw_image_pipeline: test the FFCV raw image pipeline end to end using a synthetic dataset with 500 samples
test_jpg_image_pipeline: test the FFCV JPEG image pipeline end to end using a synthetic dataset with 500 samples
